name: RIR Power Electronics SiC Semiconductor Facility, Bhubaneswar

parties.name: RIR Power Electronics
parties.note: Listed Indian maker of silicon power devices such as thyristors, rectifier diodes and modules, formerly Ruttonsha International Rectifier.

parties.name: Government of Odisha
parties.note: The state cabinet approved a customised incentive package in January 2025, and the Electronics and IT Department approved fiscal support for the first phase in August 2025.

summary: A silicon carbide power semiconductor plant that RIR Power Electronics is building in the electronics manufacturing cluster at Info Valley, Bhubaneswar, Odisha, to make SiC MOSFETs, diodes and other high-voltage devices rated from 3.3 kV to 20 kV. The INR 618.6 crore project runs in two phases: SiC epitaxial wafer growth and packaging first, then device fabrication. Ground was broken in September 2024 and the Odisha government approved incentives in 2025. The cleanroom and power supply were finished in mid-2026 and the epitaxy reactors were installed in the quarter to September 2026, but production, which the company had first expected to start with epitaxial wafers in December 2025, was still waiting on statutory and regulatory formalities in October 2026.

location.site: Electronics Manufacturing Cluster Park, Info Valley

metrics.note: INR 618.60 crore across both phases; the company and later reports round it to INR 618 crore.
INR 65 crore spent by August 2025, the basis for the first-phase capital subsidy.
INR 32 crore state capital subsidy approved for the first phase, to be paid pro rata.

milestones.note: Original target for epitaxial wafer output; missed.
Commercial production target reported to the state government in September 2025; missed.
Cleanroom construction and the 33 kV power supply were completed in the April to June 2026 quarter.
SiC epitaxial wafer reactors were installed and utilities commissioned in the July to September 2026 quarter.
The company expected operations to begin in its third fiscal quarter, October to December 2026, once remaining statutory approvals are in place.

notes: This project is supported by the Odisha government; no India Semiconductor Mission approval for it was found, and the separate SiCSem silicon carbide fab at Info Valley (india-sicsem-bhubaneswar-sic-fab) is a different project. The October 2026 release puts epitaxy and packaging in the first phase and device fabrication in the second, for which no schedule has been given; the March 2025 release had described packaging and the fab as following the epitaxy start in later years. No Odisha government page could be opened, so the state approvals are taken from news reports. The October 2026 results release (s5) is the company's statement as carried by CXOToday.

review.method: Independent AI-assisted review (Claude): re-opened every cited source, checked each statement against it and searched for newer reporting.
review.changes: Clarified that the December 2025 target was for the start of epitaxial wafer output rather than commercial production, and noted the company's two descriptions of how packaging is phased; no newer report of production was found.
